Paradise....Weed, Alcohol and E
Got lotta friends and one of them is a total dopehead so she offered me E one saturday night. Was so nervous, for a week I kept askin people if they knew somethin about E. I always club, so I decided to try it in a club!!!! DAMN!!!! So we met around 10, 4 of my friends an me and I smoked 2 joints maybe. we were chillin until 11 when we went to the club. Was feeling like I was flyin. The music was so nice and I was feelin it inside me, plus R&B really has a vibe I cant resist when I'm on dope. So we started drinkin...amaretto cranberry all night. I was gettin drunk, feeling like I was invincible, I was loosing all my inhibitions, forgettin about what OTHERS think.
I was loosing all my inhibitions, forgettin about what OTHERS think.
It was me, my trip and I was livin it to the fullest. So we started dancin to some reggae... weed+alcohol really made me horny so I was dirty dancin with NO fear, I was free.
Around 12 I popped the E. Everything was nice and all....I was drunk like hell, enjoyin everything and everyone around me. I felt like it was my place, I felt loved and all. So I guess around 1h30 the E hit me. But I didnt really feel it cuz I was so drunk.....but slowly I felt weird. Felt like a porn star! I wanted to kiss and hug every sexy guys in the club. So thats what I did. Dancin with 2 guys kissin both. Had the time of my life. I felt like our society had completly changed. I felt like everyone was good, respectul and I trusted everyone. I didnt think bad of anyone, I just thought we were like a big 'family' or sometthin. I felt a bond with everyone, like if I knew them forever. No words can explain the way I felt that night. I forgot all my problems, I wasnt even thinkin about consequences on my acts. I was like a lil kid, I was having fun without feeling guilty. I wished the feeling would never go away.
Then I started goin a lil paranoid, wonderin when it would stop, tryin to figure out a way to get more E so I would stay on top! So I went lookin for my friends, when a guy took me by the waist and started dancin with me. His touch was makin me crazyyyyyyy! I felt like my body was screamin to be rubbed and touched. The music was gettin in me, deeper and deeper. The lights were gettin warmer and I felt like I was rising!!! Felt like I was on a JET goin to paradise. I let the guy guide the dance and I was just livin it up to the fullest. Every touch, every sound was makin me dizzyyyyyy. It was so nice to feel it in me, I was gettin in total contact with my body and soul. I just closed my eyes and let the E take me in the skys. I told the guy I was dancin with, that I was on E and he really made everythin to maximise my trip.
Then I dont quite remember everything very clearly. I just remember goin in some kinda trance with my body. The music was killin me...I felt like the music was comin from my insides. And I couldnt stop thinkin how I liked the music. It was weird! Suddenly my best girl friend came to me and we started dancin. I was on top of my trip, with the alcohol, and E hittin me strong! Just closed my eyes and kissed her for an hour or so....dont remember. I just remember kissin her and dancin with her with 40 guys in circle around us, screamin.
Was 3h30 and we were still in the club talkin to the staff, as if we knew them forever. Best night ever!
I know alot of people wouldnt mix weed+alcohol+ E but I guess u have to get the right timing.
I smoked, chilled for an hour. Then drank and took the E when I was feelin real drunk, that way when the E hit, I wasnt too drunk.
I still take E, once a month cuz I dont wanna fuck my brain too much! Some people also think E in a club isnt the right thing to do. But I think everyone knows whats right for them. For me, afterhours wouldnt be the right place to take E, wouldnt feel good in that kinda place.
